mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% MoM does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market and high interest rates create a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200k jobs does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation > 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).
